Always answers 410 process-path-moved: the local declaration retired (docs/adr/0025 stage 2). A path's ordered steps now come from the process flows this context consumes from process-path-management (ProcessFlowDefined/Revised/Retired); declare a flow there as PUT /process-flows/\{flowId\}. Nothing is decoded, recorded or published for ANY body. GET /process-paths stays.
